ear.name: ear
ear.transformationDescription:
They quickly begin to shrink down a little and become rounded, and in the process also shift to sit higher up on [npc.her] head than a normal pair of human ears would. #IF(npc.getBodyMaterial()==BODY_MATERIAL_FLESH) Слой [npc.earFullDescriptionColour] быстро растет, покрывая их, #ELSE Как и остальные части [npc.targetBasedWord(твоей, [npc.her])] тела, они сделаны из [npc.earFullDescription]., #ENDIF and as the transformation finishes, [npc.she] experimentally twitch [npc.her] new capybara-like ears back and forth.
[npc.Name] now [npc.has] [style.boldCapybara(large, capybara-like ears)], которые [npc.materialCompositionDescriptor] [npc.earFullDescription].
ear.bodyDescription: У [npc.targetBasedWord(тебя, н[npc.him])] пара of small, upright,#IF(npc.isPiercedEar()) pierced,#ENDIF capybaraподобных ушей, которые расположены высоко на [npc.targetBasedWord(твоей, [npc.her])] голове и которые [pc.morphPluralParticipleToShortForm([npc.materialCompositionDescriptor])] [pc.morphSingleInstr([npc.earFullDescription(true)])].
